source: TrustLensAI_NLP_Logs_Layers_Formulas.xlsx — sheet 'NLP RMTE (Master)' plus 'Logs ↔ Formula Inputs' and 'Logs ↔ Architecture Layers'
notes: Each NLP pipeline stage emits telemetry; TrustLensAI platform layers ingest and evaluate it. TrustLensAI produces evidence; it does not certify compliance.

layers.key_fields: documents, source, language/locale, timestamps
layers.ingested_by: L0 · Foundation & Integration → L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: tokens, UNK/OOV rate, subword fragmentation, normalization, stopwords
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: features, embeddings (refs), encoder model & version
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: predictions, logits, per-class/entity/language outputs, confidence
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance
layers.notes: Core log for TP, FH families

layers.key_fields: confidence bins, ECE inputs, reliability data
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: final output, generated text, readability, entity list
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: token-level attribution (attention/SHAP/LIME), counterfactuals, provenance
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: PII detection/redaction, memorization checks, data-minimization
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: bias classifier, dialect/gender parity, adversarial-text resistance
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: task metrics (F1/ROUGE/BLEU/EM), human-eval correlation
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance (AAJ)

layers.key_fields: latency (p50/p95/p99), throughput, cost, model size/resource
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: input drift, model registry, TEVV, annotation IAA governance
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L2 · Observability → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: registered NLP models, data connectors, tenancy, model registry
layers.ingested_by: Anchors identity, model registry & tenancy for all logs

layers.key_fields: normalized NLP spans/events, redaction applied, event-bus refs
layers.ingested_by: Consumes all NLP product logs; normalizes & redacts

layers.key_fields: reconstructed pipeline traces, dependency views, time-series (drift)
layers.ingested_by: Consumes canonical events (D1-gated / target)

layers.key_fields: evaluator/judge outputs, NLI faithfulness, task metrics, scores
layers.ingested_by: Consumes inference/output/explainability logs + gold sets

layers.key_fields: metric defs, thresholds, mappings, gold sets & references, versions
layers.ingested_by: Supplies formulas/thresholds & reference data to L3
layers.notes: Governs the NLP RMTE metric corpus

layers.key_fields: fairness, privacy, annotation-governance decisions, risk register, gates
layers.ingested_by: Consumes evaluation evidence; runs release gates

layers.key_fields: Evidence Pack manifest, RFC 6962 inclusion proofs / hashes, Trust Score (Q6)
layers.ingested_by: Assembles tamper-evident evidence + verdict

layers.key_fields: persona surfaces, scorecards, reports, notifications
layers.ingested_by: Consumes evidence & verdicts for reporting
